explanation.bottleneck: The measured baseline worst path is a state flip-flop through the three-input bill decode OR to the output: 0.30 ns clock-to-Q plus 0.40 ns decode delay. The next reported register-to-register path has 9.38 ns slack, so removing the output decode may expose a different limiting path.
explanation.area_or_other_cost: Adds one bill flip-flop and its look-ahead input logic while removing the combinational bill output decode. Explicit transition equations can also change mapping and fanout. Net mapped area is unmeasured; compliance with the 278.01664000000005 um2 cap must be checked.
explanation.functional_boundaries: Retains the module name, parameter declarations and defaults, ports, synchronous active-high clear, and sole positive-edge clock. After the prescribed reset, the six state bits remain one-hot and the registered bill equals the reference current-state bill decode. This invariant includes simultaneous ten and twenty, idle cycles, and arbitrary later clear assertions. No startup assumptions are added. Equivalence is required against the frozen original under the specified default-parameter proof contract; behavior before the prescribed reset is not used to justify correctness.
explanation.rewrite: Use explicit one-hot state-bit transition equations and a synchronous look-ahead bill register. The bill register receives the bill classification of the next state on the same edge that updates the state. Thus bill no longer requires a three-state OR after the clock edge, without adding an output cycle. Shared take_twenty logic explicitly preserves ten priority.
explanation.expected_timing_gain: The intended improvement is removal of the measured OR gate from the bill output path. This is not a measured WNS improvement: the new bill-register input path, changed state loading, and mapping may determine the new worst slack. Accept only after equivalence checking and fixed-setting EDA show WNS strictly above 9.30 ns, TNS remaining 0.0 ns, and area within the cap.
output_format_normalization: Removed complete leading think wrapper before JSON parsing
